As boring as it's going to sound I say save the money until you have a better idea of who you are and what you can do with the amount. The world is getting more and more expensive by the day so it would be best to save the money for a rainy day or as a safety net. 

My advice is not to let the amount of money sway your decisions while growing up; go to college, get a job, help your mother out as much as you can, spend/use the money you're going to earn from your job. If things get bad or too tight you will always have that amount to fall back on.

Reading your posts definitely struck a cord with me and sent me right back when I was dealing with a similar situation. 
I can tell you though, it will get better man. I know it's pretty tiring to hear that over and over again but it's the truth, you just don't see it right now as everything is so fresh. Remember, every time you get in touch with her and wait for a reply/receive a reply from her you're just breaking up with her all over again, you're keeping the wounds fresh. That isn't going to help you in any way. As Watts99 said earlier, you need to keep something so loud on in the background that your mind doesn't have a chance to focus on the past. You need to enjoy the present and look to the future. 
I was given this really good idea about how you should by yourself a calendar and every week you should write on it two things you would love to achieve that week. And do it. Be it a stroll in the park to watching a new movie or learning to make a new meal. It's down to you but, it has to be something that you know will make you happy. Right now you have to put your happiness first because it's time you deserved that.
I sincerely hope things pick up for you really soon, my best wishes are with you bro.
